Changelog

gsm.ctas (development version)

First development release. gsm.ctas integrates the ctas anomaly detection engine into the gsm framework, from SDTM input through to a rendered site-level KRI report.

Mapping

  • Input_Numeric(), Input_Range(), Input_OneHot() and Input_Missing() map SDTM domains into the long-format timeseries ctas expects, one function per data type rather than per domain, so the same code serves VS, LB and RS. Domain-specific detail lives in the workflow YAML spec.
  • Input_Subjects() maps subject and site metadata.
  • Combine_CTAS_Input() binds these into the frames ctas::process_a_study() requires.

Preparation

  • Prepare_Normalize() rescales a value by its reference range, making different tests comparable.
  • Prepare_MissingRatio() derives a missingness ratio over time per subject and parameter.
  • Prepare_Categorical() one-hot encodes categorical results into indicator timeseries.
  • Prepare_TimepointRank() recomputes timepoint_rank after filtering or binding.

Analysis

  • Analyze_CTAS() wraps ctas::process_a_study() with reproducible seeding and informative errors for degenerate studies, rather than an opaque failure deep inside the engine.
  • Summarize_CTAS() aggregates timeseries-level scores into the gsm Analysis_Analyzed contract, one row per site. Sites with no evaluated timeseries are retained with Denominator = 0 and Score = NA, so the report cannot silently drop them.
  • Flag_CTAS() flags one-sided (0/1/2). The -log10(p) scale is unsigned, so a flag says that a site differs, not in which direction.
  • Combine_CTAS_Scores() assembles scores across parameter families.

Reporting

  • DropChart() removes the stock scatter plot from the KRI report. That chart plots Denominator against Numerator, which suits a rate metric where the denominator is exposure; here it is a coverage count, near-identical across sites, so the points collapse onto one x position.
  • No Analysis_Input is emitted. CTAS has no subject-level numerator/denominator, so synthesising one would render misleadingly. The stock gsm.kri site report does not require it.

Drill-down

  • Combine_CTAS_Detail() and Write_CTAS_Detail() retain and export the timeseries-level detail that aggregation discards, for handoff to the ctasapp dashboard. csv and, via Suggests: arrow, parquet.

Workflows

  • All four gsm workflow layers ship in inst/workflow/: 1_mappings (including CTAS_Input, CTAS_SiteScores and CTAS_Detail), 2_metrics (ctas0001-ctas0011), 3_reporting and 4_modules.
  • ctas::process_a_study() runs once per study, in 1_mappings/CTAS_SiteScores.yaml; each metric workflow filters that shared result to one parameter family and one feature. Adding a metric is a YAML change, not a code change.
  • Thresholds are configurable via meta and ParseThreshold. The defaults 2.326 and 0.842 are one-sided normal z-quantiles (99% and 80%) on a -log10(p) scale, adopted for consistency with existing CTAS review practice.

Documentation

  • vignette("gsm-ctas") walks the full pipeline and both customisation paths.
  • pkgdown site with a reference index organised by pipeline stage.
